as_told.title: UFO cover-up began as a presidential emergency action document

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon studies of UFOs, told Jesse Michels in 2026 that the presidential emergency action directives, secret orders for what the White House does in a crisis, were started under President Eisenhower in the 1950s. Davis says these rules are very strict and have been carried forward on many topics, and that he and Jim Semivan, a former CIA officer, know they were set up for UFOs too. If true, UFO secrecy would sit inside some of the government's most guarded orders.
